summary: BUG-296-R2 fix verification: Food Court addon+variation prices now included in itemTotal. Tested CREAMBELLPARLOUR for June 2026 — Item Total is ₹2,57,012.45 (was ₹2,36,427.45), an increase of ~₹20,585 representing addons+variations. Audit tab loads cleanly with 6038 orders, DRIFT=₹0 across all stations. All stations combined Item Total = ₹18,71,131.61 (vs old ₹18,06,549.45).
critical_code_review_comments: Food Court report takes ~40 seconds to load June 2026 data (batch API call for 30-day range) — this is expected behavior per CR-013 batching design, not a bug
context_for_next_testing_agent: BUG-296-R2 fix is verified and working. CREAMBELLPARLOUR June 2026 Item Total = ₹2,57,012.45 (expected ~₹257,012). Audit tab shows all 4 stations (CREAMBELLPARLOUR, GUPTAJEE, MSB, ZORKO) + UNASSIGNED with DRIFT=₹0. Total Item Total across all stations = ₹18,71,131.61.
